Siden Anders Kirk Johansen overtog godse: Since Anders Kirk Johansen took over the estate in 2003, the estate has undergone major improvements. Alt sammen udført med stor respekt for e: All done with great respect for the history of the property, the environment and the local community.
Ambitionen er at føre Rohden ind i en ny: The ambition is to lead Rohden into a new era, without compromising the soul and unique atmosphere of the place.
Skov- og landbruget på Rohden Gods: Forestry and agriculture at Rohden Gods
Rohden omfatter et større landbrugsareal: Rohden comprises a large agricultural area, which is run as a modern farm with varying crop rotation, with a focus on quality crops and with great regard for the property's natural value.
Skovbruget under Rohden dækker et samlet: The forestry under Rohden covers a total area of ​​161 hectares plus five hectares in lease, and is run as a traditional forestry. The primary vegetation in the forests is deciduous forest, approximately 75 percent, while the secondary vegetation in the forests is coniferous forest,
cirka 25 procent. Nåletræerne er fordelt: approximately 25 percent. The conifers are distributed over the entire forest area, which provides good cover for the forest's rich wildlife.
Jagten og vildtbestanden er en vigtig de: Hunting and the game population are an important part of the cultural heritage at Rohden
Jagtarealerne er derfor kendetegnet af e: The hunting areas are therefore characterized by a very high standard of hunting ethics and a healthy and natural animal population.
På Rohden anses det som en af de vigtigs: At Rohden, it is considered one of the most important tasks to take care of the game and the natural wildlife. The hunts at Rohden are occasionally rented out for shooting events and for, among other things, day hunts for ducks, pheasants and wild game. Rohden Estates is also registered with the Sustainable Hunting labeling scheme.

Salg af bil til udlandet | Læs om ekspor: Sale of car abroad | Read about the export of used cars | MY GARAGE
Går du med overvejelser om at sælge din: Are you considering selling your car abroad? In some cases, sending your car south is a good idea, but figuring out how to go about it can be a jungle.
Hvorfor kan det betale sig at sælge bile: Why does it pay to sell the car abroad?
I Danmark har de fleste af os vores bile: In Denmark, most of us are very fond of our cars. This means that we don't have to drive around in a car with scratches and dents. Do you have a car with a few scratches and a fair amount of wear and tear? Then you can most likely get a better price for it abroad. This is due, among other things, to the cheaper salaries and operating costs, which are worth considering with the high competition and the cars' rapid loss of value here in Denmark.
Der er flere metoder, som du kan vælge a: There are several methods that you can choose to use if you want to sell your car. First of all, you can choose to enter into a collaboration with a professional company that exports cars and knows what it takes. A professional company makes sure to find the right buyer and do the work, so that you only have to do the very minimum - completely without worry. Of course, it costs money, but in return you avoid all the trouble and uncertainty along the way.
Du kan også vælge selv at stå for ekspor: You can also choose to be responsible for the export yourself. In that case, there are a few different steps that you have to manage yourself in relation to the export regulations.
Din bil skal have et udvidet registrerin: Your car must have an extended registration inspection incl. customs inspection when you have chosen to export. The vision must not be older than 4 weeks when you ask for the valuation, which is the next step.
Du skal anmode Motorstyrelsen om at værd: You must request the Motor Authority to value your vehicle. The case processing has a fee of DKK 2,350, and this must be paid as soon as you ask for the valuation. You can do all this by logging into the Motor Register and filling in the request. The Danish Motor Agency has the right to summon your vehicle for an inspection - normally within 14 days.
Dine nummerplader skal afleveres til en: Your number plates must be handed over to a number plate operator or in a motor expedition so that your vehicle can get new ones abroad.
Du har krav på at indsende dokumentation: You have the right to submit documentation to the Motor Authority on ownership of the vehicle, sale of the vehicle and the export itself.
Dernæst udbetaler Motorstyrelsen registr: Next, the Motor Authority pays the registration fee to your account - optimally approx. 9 weeks.
Alle køretøjer, fra autocamper til motor: All vehicles, from motorhomes to motorcycles, with a weight up to 3,500 kg can be exported.
Når du eksporterer, kan du få udbetalt e: When you export, you can be paid an export allowance. It is based on the tax that you paid when you bought the car at the time - minus 15% or min. DKK 8,500 for cars and DKK 4,500 for vans.
SKAT har krav på toldsyn på alle køretøj: SKAT is entitled to a customs inspection of all vehicles declared for export.
Eksportgodtgørelsen bortfalder, hvis der: The export allowance is waived if a mortgage, attachment or similar has been registered.

Porsche 911 964 Carrera 4 – A true milestone in Porsche history
We now have an iconic Porsche 911 964 Carrera 4 for sale at MY GARAGE, and it is a very special model in Porsche's history.

The 964 Carrera 4 marked a historic chapter for the 911 model with the introduction of four-wheel drive in the classic 911 series.

Inspired by Porsche's enormous success in the world of rallying, not least with the legendary 959 and the experiences from motorsport, the Carrera 4 was developed with an advanced four-wheel drive that distributed the forces between the front and rear axles and provided impressive road grip and stability.

The 964 Carrera 4 thus united the classic air-cooled 911 character with technology from Porsche's motorsport heritage. This model is a true milestone in 911 history.

Even the most skilled Porsche enthusiast will appreciate our example. A car that has been used, driven and looked after over the years, and which at the same time comes with history and just the right patina.

Privatleasing: Hvilke omkostninger har d: Private leasing: What costs do you have?
Når du leaser, er bilen ejet af nogle an: When you lease, the car is owned by someone other than you. In return, you pay a monthly fee to have the right to use the car over a time frame. So you don't have to worry about the high amount needed to buy the car. Instead, you pay an initial benefit, which is determined based on the car in question.
Førstegangsydelsen betales, inden du får: The initial payment is paid before you get the car in your care, and then it is just the monthly payment that you have to pay afterwards. The initial payment should not be seen as a deposit, as it is not money you get back after the end of the leasing period.
Din månedlige leasingydelse er ligesom e: Your monthly lease payment is like rent. It is also determined according to the car's type and size as well as the number of kilometers and what else your leasing contract contains.
Som udgangspunkt er det de eneste udgift: As a starting point, these are the only expenses you have for leasing. As long as you don't exceed the mileage limit, you have a firm overview of what it costs to lease the car.
Det er umuligt at komme med et klart sva: It is impossible to come up with a clear answer to what it costs to lease a car. There are a number of factors that come into play - including which car you lease, number of kilometers in the contract, where you lease it, and how the leasing contract is structured in relation to extra expenses.
Du har altså førstegangsydelsen og den f: So you have the initial payment and the fixed, monthly leasing payment. In addition, extra expenses such as insurance and environmental tax may be included in the leasing contract, which thus also provides an additional payment for you who lease.
Men kan det så virkelig betale sig at pr: But is it really worth private leasing when there is now both an initial payment and a monthly payment?
Førstegangsydelsen er naturligvis meget: The initial payment is naturally much lower than the price you pay when you buy a car via a car loan. You can therefore get the right to use a car for a lower amount.
Den månedlige ydelse dækker i langt de f: In the vast majority of cases, the monthly benefit covers the unforeseen costs that you are likely to encounter as a car owner.
Privatleasing giver dig mulighed for at: Private leasing allows you to replace your car more frequently. You agree with the leasing company how long you lease the car, and it is typically only 2-3 years at a time.
Hvis du vil regne de samlede udgifter ud: If you want to work out the total expenses, you just need to add the initial payment together with all the monthly payments - including fuel - and then you will get a clear picture of your expenses.
Overvejer du at lease en bil?: Are you considering leasing a car?
Har du kraftige overvejelser om at lease: Are you seriously considering leasing a car? Then it is a good idea to form an overview before you kickstart the process.
Tænk over, hvad dit overordnede behov er: Think about what your overall need is. How long do you want to lease the car and how far do you need to drive during that period? This gives you the best conditions for limiting yourself to offers that are actually useful for you.

Er dit forbrug derimod svingende, og har: If, on the other hand, your consumption fluctuates, and you have difficulty with the idea of ​​limiting yourself in terms of kilometers and time, then buying a car might be more advantageous for you in the end.
Få sikkerhed i økonomien ved at privatle: Get financial security by private leasing
Et bilkøb rummer store udgifter som selv: A car purchase entails large expenses such as the financing itself, service, depreciation and wear and tear. All expenses that are included in the monthly payment on your leasing agreement.
Det er altså svært at vurdere, om det er: It is therefore difficult to assess whether it is best to be a car owner or to lease - it all depends on your driving pattern and your overall situation.
Mange, der leaser, oplever at de opnår e: Many who lease find that they achieve greater financial security because they can make a clear budget, where there is not the same risk of unforeseen expenses, unless you exceed the kilometer limit - which is your own responsibility.
Det handler altså om at opveje fordelene: It is therefore about balancing the advantages and disadvantages and, based on that, finding the solution that best matches your needs. When you buy your own car, you are responsible for everything, but you also experience no restrictions. When you lease a car, many people enjoy it because it is both easy, convenient and safe.
I nogle tilfælde vil leasing være den bi: In some cases, leasing will be the cheapest solution for you, and in other cases, a car purchase will pay off best. Går du med overvejelser om at lease en b: If you are considering leasing a car, operational leasing may be the right solution for you. Her på siden kan du blive meget klogere: On this page, you can learn much more about what operational leasing is and what the form of leasing entails. Read along here and get help to assess whether operational leasing is the right choice for you.
Operationel leasing er en leasingform, h: Operational leasing is a form of leasing where you rent a vehicle for a leasing period, after which the car can be returned to the lessor. During the entire leasing period, the leasing company bears all operating costs because a service agreement is attached as part of the service. It gives you more security in terms of your budget, as the service agreement usually involves trips to the workshop and refilling the car with oil, washer fluid and the like. In this way, it is also the most risk-free form of leasing, and therefore often also the most expensive form of leasing.
Ved operationel leasing betales der et e: With operational leasing, a lump sum is paid when the car is handed over, and then a monthly amount is paid for the leasing of the car throughout the leasing period.
Efter endt leasingperiode ejer du ikke b: After the end of the leasing period, you do not own the car, and you have no obligations in connection with it. Here, the car is simply handed back to the leasing company.
Flexleasing er ikke operationel leasing,: Flexleasing is not operational leasing, but rather financial leasing. When you choose flex leasing (financial leasing), the leasing works almost like a form of buying a car in installments, while operational leasing (private leasing) is a rental of the car.
Operationel leasing bogføres under drift: Operational leasing is booked under operating costs in your profit and loss account, as you lease a product. With operational leasing, the leasing fee is deductible, and you therefore get a deduction for the costs of your car. There is no VAT charge on the purchase price.

Her på siden bliver du klogere på, hvad: On this page, you will learn more about what financial leasing is and how the form of leasing differs from other types of leasing, so that you can assess whether this form of leasing is the right choice for you.
Finansiel leasing er en type leasingafta: Financial leasing is a type of leasing agreement where the car is financed through the leasing company. The leasing company has the ownership of the car throughout the period, while the lessee pays a fixed amount and a low percentage of the car's registration fee monthly for the use of the car. Therefore, financial leasing can be compared more to the purchase of a car that is paid for in instalments.
Efter leasingperioden er slut, er din vi: After the leasing period is over, your company is obliged to either buy the car or find a new buyer yourself.
Hvad er forskellen på finansiel og opera: What is the difference between financial and operational leasing?
. Finansiel leasing anvendes typisk til: . Financial leasing is typically used for flex leasing, while operational leasing is typically used for private leasing.
En af de største forskelle på finansiel: One of the biggest differences between financial and operational leasing is the condition after the end of the leasing period. With operational leasing, the car can be returned to us after the end of the leasing period, while with financial leasing, you have to buy the car yourself or find a new buyer yourself, as you have monthly installments on the car as a form of payment.
Finansiel leasing egner sig bedst til ek: Financial leasing is best suited for exclusive cars at the more expensive end, where it would otherwise not be financially realistic to buy the car yourself. By choosing financial leasing, you get the opportunity to drive a luxurious car without having to ask for a car loan from the bank. Instead, you pay off the residual value of the car with a fixed monthly amount, and there will therefore also be no interest on the car, as there would be by taking out a car loan from the bank.
Vælger du finansiel leasing, er der hell: If you choose financial leasing, there is also no mileage restriction, and it is therefore also a good option for you who cannot predict how much you will drive the car, or for you who have to drive many kilometers daily.

Award-winning for its architecture, the academy exhibits the cars that have shaped Dallara's history – from the Lamborghini Miura to the latest IndyCars and Stradale.
Dallara er en virksomhed, hvor tradition: Dallara is a company where tradition and technology meet. They are both a development partner for major car manufacturers, a supplier of racing car chassis and a training ground for the engineers of the future – and they continue to set the standard for what is possible in the world of motorsport.

Faktorer, der afgør prisen for at lade e: Factors that determine the price of charging an electric car
Omkostningerne ved at lade en elbil op a: The cost of charging an electric car depends on several factors, including the size of the electric car's battery, the driving pattern and the price of electricity in your area.
Der er også forskel på, om du vælger at: There is also a difference between whether you choose to charge your electric car at public charging stations, with fast charging, or whether you charge it at home. There may be various charges and fees at public chargers that affect the total price of charging your electric car.
Prisen for at oplade din elbil er dog ge: However, the price of charging your electric car is generally lower than refueling a car with petrol or diesel.
Sådan beregner du omkostningerne for opl: How to calculate the costs for charging your electric car at home or at public charging stations
Når du skal beregne prisen på at lade di: When you have to calculate the price of charging your electric car, you must pay attention to the size of the car's battery, the current price of electricity and the charging speed.
Beregn prisen på, hvad det koster at lad: Calculate the price of what it costs to charge an electric car:
Find størrelsen på bilens batteri: Find the size of the car's battery
Batteriets størrelse kan som oftest ses: The size of the battery can usually be seen in the specifications of your electric car.
Find prisen for elektricitet pr. kWh i d: Find the price of electricity per kWh in your area
Du kan finde prisen på elektricitet på d: You can find the price of electricity on your electricity bill or find the information from your electricity provider.
Find opladningshastigheden for din bil: Find the charging speed for your car
Opladningshastigheden kan variere alt ef: The charging speed may vary depending on whether you charge at home or at public charging stations.
Omkostningerne for opladning af din elbi: The costs for charging your electric car can therefore be calculated as follows:
Prisen for at lade en elbil op = batteri: The price for charging an electric car = battery size in kWh x price per kWh x the efficiency of the charging process in percent
Hastigheden for opladningsprocessen i pr: The speed of the charging process in percentage depends on, among other things, the temperature and the age of the battery, which can usually be checked in the specifications of the car.
Vær opmærksom på, at ovenstående eksempe: Please note that the above example is just a guide and that there may be other factors that can affect the price of charging your electric car. At public charging stations, for example, there may be fees and charges that must be added to the price.
Forskellige muligheder for at lade din e: Different options for charging your electric car at home
Vil du gerne have muligheden for at lade: Would you like to be able to charge your electric car at home? Most electric cars come with a cable for charging using a regular socket (230V), but it is also possible to install a charging station for your electric car at home.
At have din egen ladestation i hjemmet e: Having your own charging station at home is usually the most optimal and practical way to charge the electric car – and also the fastest method.
En dedikeret ladestation er ofte en mere: A dedicated charging station is often a more convenient way to charge the electric car, and at the same time it can increase the charging speed. In addition, the charging station in the home can also be safer to use rather than a regular socket.
Det kan altså oftest godt betale sig at: It therefore often pays to install a dedicated charging station for your electric car at home. We recommend that you contact an authorized electrical installer to ensure that the installation is carried out safely and complies with local requirements and regulations.

The name 2‑Eleven is a tribute to the iconic Lotus Eleven from 1956 – a car that made motorsport history at Le Mans. With 2‑Eleven, you don't just get a modern racer; you get a part of Lotus's DNA, created to continue the tradition of innovation and victory.

Er du på udkig efter en ny bil, men ønsk: Are you looking for a new car, but don't want too many expenses for purchase, repair and maintenance? Then private leasing may be the right choice for you. It could also be that you are a big car enthusiast who has chosen a new dream car for you? With private car leasing, there is plenty of opportunity to be allowed to drive just the cars you long for, and private leasing is an obvious opportunity to explore a lot of cool vehicles.
Her på siden dykker vi ned emnet, herund: On this page, we delve into the subject, including the costs associated with private leasing and the many advantages of leasing your car.
Privatleasing er, når du som privatperso: Private leasing is when you, as a private person, rent a car long-term - and therefore do not lease through your workplace. The only difference between private and business leasing is whether you lease the car for your own use, or whether it is the company that leases the car at the disposal of an employee.
Når du privatleaser en bil, får du brugs: When you privately lease a car, you get the right to use the car over the agreed period in which you lease the car. When leasing a car for private use, you pay an amount for payment, and then an amount is paid continuously every month during the period of the lease. You can enter into different leasing agreements, and they can vary, among other things, depending on the type of car and where you choose to lease.
Selvom leasing ofte er et spørgsmål om s: Although leasing is often a matter of taste and preference, there are many advantages to privately leasing a car.
Nedenfor har vi samlet nogle af de forde: Below we have collected some of the advantages of privately leasing your car.
Når du leaser din bil privat, vil du oft: When you lease your car privately, you will often experience lower monthly costs than buying a car yourself. This is most often the case because you are not paying for the full value of the car, but instead only for the loss in value of the car during the leasing period.
Mulighed for at udskifte din bil med jæv: Option to replace your car at regular intervals
Ved at lease en bil har du mulighed for: By leasing a car, you have the opportunity to replace your car at intervals of, for example, 2 or 3 years. It is a great advantage if you – like us at MY GARAGE – are a car enthusiast who wants to test and explore different types of cars. Here you get the opportunity to test the latest technology and safety systems.
Som oftest er service og kontrol af bile: In most cases, servicing and checking of the car is included in the monthly service paid according to your leasing agreement. This means that there will not be a lot of unforeseen expenses with your car, as there are when you have bought and own the car yourself. You also don't have to worry about selling the car again when the leasing period is over.
Mange leasingaftaler er meget fleksible,: Many leasing agreements are very flexible, so you can often adapt the leasing period and the agreement so that it best suits you, your budget and your situation.
Omkostningerne for at privatlease en bil: The cost of privately leasing a car depends on several factors. This includes the brand on the car, the lease period, model and equipment, the number of kilometers and whether service, inspection and maintenance are included in the lease agreement. Leasing agreements are not the same for all companies, and therefore prices and conditions look different depending on the agreement.
Du kan forvente at betale et fast månedl: You can expect to pay a fixed monthly amount throughout the lease term, and the monthly payment also varies by the same factors explained above. At MY GARAGE, you can see the monthly service on the specific car.

Test plates give, among other things, the opportunity to test drive vehicles at car dealers, which you also have the opportunity to do here at MY GARAGE.
Her på siden kan du blive klogere på, hv: On this page, you can learn more about what sample plates are, how they work and which rules apply to the use of sample plates.
Prøveplader kaldes også for prøvemærker: Trial plates are also called trial marks and trial plates, and are a kind of temporary license plate. Test plates are valid for seven days, unless you have permanent test plates, and you can drive with test plates as long as you just pay for them.
En prøveplade bruges til at identificere: A test plate is used to identify a vehicle while it is undergoing a trial period or test drive. They are therefore used temporarily on the vehicle before it is registered with permanent number plates. The main difference from a permanent license plate is that a trial license plate consists of four red digits as opposed to the seven digits found on license plates.
Hvad er reglerne for prøveplader?: What are the rules for sample plates?
Der kan være flere årsager til ikke at h: There can be several reasons for not having a number plate on your car. According to the Motor Authority, test plates must be used when there is a "special purpose" for driving. This can, for example, be during a test drive at a car dealer where the car is not registered. Here, there is a special purpose for the drive, as there is interest in buying the car, which is why car dealers always have test plates available.
Der er forskellige regler for, hvornår p: There are different rules for when sample plates may and may not be used, and you can find out more about some of the rules below. We refer to
for at finde alle regler for prøvemærker: to find all rules for test marks and fixed test signs.
Hvornår må prøveplader bruges?: When can sample plates be used?
Prøveplader må blandt andet bruges i sit: Sample plates may, among other things, be used in situations where you:
Prøvekører eller testkører et køretøj i: Test drive or test drive a vehicle in connection with a possible purchase.
Prøvekører køretøjet i forbindelse med r: Test drives the vehicle in connection with repairs.
Afhenter eller bringer en bil i forbinde: Collects or delivers a car in connection with repair, purchase, leasing, sale and preparation.
Overfører bilen fra ét sted til et andet: Transferring the car from one place to another, for example to another dealer, leasing company, warehouse or other.
Hvornår må prøveplader ikke bruges?: When must sample plates not be used?
Prøveplader må blandt andet ikke bruges: Sample plates must not be used, among other things, for the following:
At flytte et påhængskøretøj såsom en cam: To move a trailer such as a caravan from one place to another.
Fornøjelsesture i et køretøj, der ikke e: Pleasure trips in an unregistered vehicle.
Hvor længe må man køre med prøveplader?: How long can you drive with test plates?
Prøveplader er gyldige i syv dage, hvor: Trial plates are valid for seven days, during which time they give you permission to drive your vehicle on Danish roads without a number plate.
Må man køre ud af landet med prøveplader: Can you drive out of the country with test plates?
Du må gerne køre ud af landet med prøvep: You may drive out of the country with test plates. However, you must be aware that you may not drive into Denmark with Danish license plates, as you must have German license plates when you cross the border into Denmark from Germany.
Skal du have indregistreret en bil, du h: If you must have registered a car you bought in, for example, Germany, it is also possible to drive to and from the inspection hall on test plates.
